Subject: Vendor registration kickoff — Northside Supplies (Ariba & Ivalua)

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for agreeing to get Northside set up in our procurement systems. To keep the first PO and onboarding sprint on track, can you please complete the items below by end of week (EOW Friday, Feb 26)?

Quick checklist (minimal items to unblock PO creation):
- Confirm legal entity exactly as it appears on W-9 / tax docs (full registered name).
- Upload completed W-9 and ACH form to our secure intake (or reply to this thread).
- Register in Ariba supplier portal (link below) and accept the Redwood supplier invite.
- Register in Ivalua onboarding portal and complete the company profile.
- Provide contact for invoices/POs and remittance address.

Ariba supplier registration: https://supplier.ariba.com/register?org=redwood
Ivalua onboarding: https://portal.ivalua.com/suppliers/onboard?token=XYZ123

Notes / common gotchas we see: if your legal name on the W-9 contains punctuation or differs from the name used for your bank/TIN, the portals sometimes create duplicate accounts or reject registrations. If you hit any errors, forward screenshots and we will coordinate manual provisioning with procurement operations.

If it's easier, attach the W-9 + ACH PDF in a reply and I can kick off manual vendor creation while you sort the portal invites.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with procurement ops and our payments team once I have the docs.

Diego Fernandez
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Diego — thanks for the checklist. Quick update: I tried both portal links this morning but ran into two separate problems:

1) Ariba registration failed with this error: "Legal name does not match existing records (possible duplicate)". Our legal name is "Northside Supplies, LLC" but our marketing site and invoices often use "Northside-Supplies" (hyphen) — could that be the cause?

2) Ivalua flagged the tax ID field as invalid unless entered without dashes (their validator expects 9 digits). I tried both formats and got inconsistent behavior.

Also, I did not receive any Redwood supplier invite via email (I checked spam). I attached the W-9 you requested and a screenshot of the Ariba error.

Attachments: W-9_NorthsideSupplies.pdf; ariba-error-screenshot.png

Can you escalate to your procurement team to either (a) resend the invite from a different sender address, or (b) create the vendor manually so we can start the PO? We can confirm bank details after the vendor record exists.

- I will coordinate resend of invites and follow up with Ariba support if needed (I can also ask them to accept alternate legal name spellings for the invite).

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and timeline:
1) Today (Sun Feb 21): procurement creates manual vendor record and shares vendor code.
2) Mon Feb 22: procurement maps vendor to Redwood PO workflows; payments team requests bank verification.
3) Tue Feb 23: first PO issued (if vendor is verified).

Please confirm and loop me on the vendor master ticket number and any DocuSign links you want Sarah to sign for vendor terms. I attached Sarah's W-9 and the Ariba error screenshot she sent.
